scripts.coverage:client: npm --prefix QuizLive.Client run test:coverage && dotnet tool restore && dotnet reportgenerator -reports:"QuizLive.Client/coverage/cobertura-coverage.xml" -targetdir:QuizLive.Client/coverage/summary -reporttypes:"MarkdownSummaryGithub;TextSummary"
scripts.coverage:server: dotnet tool restore && dotnet test QuizLive.Server.Tests/QuizLive.Server.Tests.csproj --settings QuizLive.Server.Tests/coverlet.runsettings --collect "XPlat Code Coverage" --results-directory coverage/server/raw && dotnet reportgenerator -reports:"coverage/server/raw/**/coverage.cobertura.xml" -targetdir:coverage/server/report -reporttypes:"Html;Cobertura;MarkdownSummaryGithub;TextSummary"
